mapper.sql: id, refund_no, request_id, order_id, payment_attempt_id, user_id, status, currency, amount_minor, reason_code, reason_note, provider_refund_id, requested_by, succeeded_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT r.refund_no, r.status, r.currency, r.amount_minor, r.reason_code, r.reason_note, r.succeeded_at, r.created_at, o.order_no, o.product_snapshot FROM refund_order r JOIN billing_order o ON o.id = r.order_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT refund_no FROM refund_order WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND updated_at <= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 10 SECOND) ORDER BY updated_at LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM billing_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_minor), 0) FROM refund_order WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status IN ('PROCESSING', 'SUCCEEDED')
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity_micros - remaining_micros), 0) FROM entitlement_grant WHERE source_type = 'ORDER' AND source_id = #{orderNo}
SELECT * FROM entitlement_grant WHERE source_type = 'ORDER' AND source_id = #{orderNo} FOR UPDATE
SELECT p.*, o.order_no, o.status AS order_status, o.user_id, o.account_id FROM payment_attempt p JOIN billing_order o ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE p.payment_no = #{paymentNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT r.*, o.order_no, p.payment_no FROM refund_order r JOIN billing_order o ON o.id = r.order_id JOIN payment_attempt p ON p.id = r.payment_attempt_id WHERE r.refund_no = #{refundNo}
FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM payment_attempt WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(remaining_micros), 0) FROM entitlement_grant WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND remaining_micros > 0 AND valid_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))
